en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Course objective: To acquire basic theoretical knowledge and practical skills for preparing the horse for hippo-therapy. General competences: - skills at applying and processing information - ability to apply the information in practice - ability to work on one's own - team work - basic professional know-how Course-related competences: - acquiring basic theoretical knowledge and practical skills to prepare the horse for hippo-therapy
